suleyman.name: Sultan Süleyman

base.name: Firman
base.text: After Plotting, swap a Vizier for an eligible player, even under Seal. The loser draws 1 Intrigue card.

suleyman.flavor: The Shadow of God on Earth!

hurrem.name: Hürrem Sultan

base.name: Whisper
base.text: At the Decree, you pick which Vizier it falls on, instead of Süleyman.

favor.name: Double Game
favor.text: Play two cards in one wave instead of one.

hurrem.flavor: Sold as a slave, she married the Sultan.

ibrahim.name: Pargalı İbrahim

base.name: Grand Vizier
base.text: This crisis, you appoint both Viziers instead of Süleyman, yourself included.

favor.name: Voice of the Divan
favor.text: Whenever Service is played while you're a Vizier, gain 1 Influence.

ibrahim.flavor: A fisherman's son from Parga, the Sultan's right hand.

sahsultan.name: Şah Sultan

base.name: Veto
base.text: On your Objection turn, object for free and pick who takes the seat. This is your Objection this crisis.

favor.name: Exile
favor.text: Pick a player: next crisis, nothing can make them a Vizier.

sahsultan.flavor: Selim the Grim's daughter; the palace heeds her word.

mustafa.name: Prince Mustafa

base.name: Heir Apparent
base.text: After Plotting, before the Firman, take a Vizier's seat if eligible, even under Seal.

favor.name: Love of the Janissaries
favor.text: Whoever objects to you pays you the Influence.

mustafa.flavor: The army's darling, heir to the throne.

hatice.name: Hatice Sultan

base.name: Patronage
base.text: Before Plotting, pick a player: this crisis, Intrigue cards can't unseat them and they lose no Influence at all.

favor.name: Intuition
favor.text: Pick two players besides Süleyman and yourself: learn in secret if they're on the same side.

hatice.flavor: The Sultan's sister, the Grand Vizier's wife.

rustem.name: Rüstem Pasha

base.name: Private Audience
base.text: Before Süleyman appoints, talk with him alone for one minute.

favor.name: Deflect
favor.text: When a wave flips, move an Intrigue card played on you to another player.

rustem.flavor: A patient, calculating man; he knows every door.

base.name: Plunder
base.text: Steal a random Intrigue card from another player, then discard to your hand limit.

favor.name: Lookout
favor.text: After the Fate step, secretly see what the First Vizier discarded.

gritti.name: Signor Gritti

base.name: Interest
base.text: Pick a player. The next time they gain Influence, you gain 1 too.

favor.name: Venetian Post
favor.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Fate cards; you may put one on the bottom.

gritti.flavor: The Doge's son, the merchant of Galata.

sarlken.name: Charles V

base.name: Abdication
base.text: When appointed, before objections, give your seat to an eligible player and gain 1 Influence. You don't draw.

favor.name: Plus Ultra
favor.text: Your Intrigue cards count as cards of an open field.

sarlken.flavor: Emperor of the West, the Sultan's rival.

tahmasp.name: Shah Tahmasp

base.name: Front
base.text: When the Crisis card flips, pick this crisis's field: Divan, Harem or Palace.

favor.name: Scorched Earth
favor.text: Everyone, you included, keeps 1 chosen Intrigue card and discards the rest.

tahmasp.flavor: The shah beyond the eastern border.

daye.name: Daye Hatun
daye.text: Play any Intrigue card as Mother's Demand; you can't pick yourself.
daye.flavor: The Queen Mother's secrets sit on Daye's tongue.

bali.name: Malkoçoğlu
bali.text: Play any Intrigue card as Seal.
bali.flavor: A raider's sword waits at the palace gate.

ayas.name: Ayas Pasha
ayas.text: Play any Intrigue card as Dismissal.
ayas.flavor: He knows first which vizier is next to fall.

matrakci.name: Matrakçı Nasuh
matrakci.text: Play any Intrigue card as Deduction.
matrakci.flavor: His pen is as sharp as his sword.

sumbul.name: Sümbül Agha
sumbul.text: Play any Intrigue card as Counterplot; you choose its field.
sumbul.flavor: Whatever happens in the harem reaches his ear first.

nigar.name: Nigar Kalfa
nigar.text: Play any Intrigue card as Sealed Letter.
nigar.flavor: She carries the letters, then reads them.

ebussuud.name: Ebussuud Efendi
ebussuud.text: Play any Intrigue card as Audit.
ebussuud.flavor: Fatwas and ledgers alike pass through his hands.

gulsah.name: Gülşah Hatun
gulsah.text: Play any Intrigue card as Slander.
gulsah.flavor: She'll tell any lie for her mistress.

seker.name: Şeker Agha
seker.text: Play any Intrigue card as Taster.
seker.flavor: Every bite for the Sultan's table passes him first.

gulfem.name: Gülfem Hatun
gulfem.text: Play any Intrigue card as Pledge.
gulfem.flavor: The Sultan's oldest friend, his quietest witness.

iskender.name: İskender Çelebi
iskender.text: Play any Intrigue card as Treasurer.
iskender.flavor: The treasury's accounts live in his ledger.

firuze.name: Firuze Hatun
firuze.text: Play any Intrigue card as Royal Gaze.
firuze.flavor: She knows the way to the Sultan's heart.

gulaga.name: Gül Agha
gulaga.text: Play any Intrigue card as Silence.
gulaga.flavor: He teaches the concubines palace manners.

lokman.name: Lokman Agha
lokman.text: Play any Intrigue card as Sentry.
lokman.flavor: He guards the Sultan's door, and what lies behind it.

akil-hocasi.name: Counterplot
akil-hocasi.text: Cancels every other Intrigue card of its field placed on this player this crisis.
akil-hocasi.flavor: See the scheme, and you won't fall for it.

muhur.name: Seal
muhur.text: Place on a Vizier. Intrigue cards can't replace them this crisis; the Firman still can.
muhur.flavor: Whoever holds the seal holds the word.

valide.name: Mother's Demand
valide.text: Place on a Vizier. Replace them with an eligible player; you may pick yourself. The newcomer takes the same seat.
valide.flavor: The Queen Mother has the last word.

azil.name: Dismissal
azil.text: Place on a Vizier. Süleyman replaces them with an eligible player, who takes the same seat.
azil.flavor: One word from the Sultan, and a vizier is done.

casus.name: Deduction
casus.text: After Plotting, see in secret which Intrigue cards this player played this crisis, and on whom.
casus.flavor: When the sums add up, the culprit shows.

muhurlu-evrak.name: Sealed Letter
muhurlu-evrak.text: Look in secret at the top 3 Fate cards and put them back in order.
muhurlu-evrak.flavor: A letter read without breaking the seal.

saray-tabibi.name: Taster
saray-tabibi.text: This player loses no Influence this crisis, Decree included.

iftira.name: Slander
iftira.flavor: A name, a whisper, a fall.

kefalet.name: Pledge
kefalet.text: Place on a Vizier. If still a Vizier at the Fate step: you gain 1 Influence on Service, lose 1 on Treason.
kefalet.flavor: Vouch for a man, and his debt is yours.

teftis.name: Audit
teftis.text: Place on a Vizier. After the Fate step, secretly see what that Vizier discarded.

defterdar.name: Treasurer
defterdar.text: Place on the First Vizier. At Fate, if still seated, they draw 4 cards, not 3, and discard 2.
defterdar.flavor: Who knows the accounts knows which line to strike.

nobet.name: Sentry
nobet.text: After Plotting, pick a card others played on this player this crisis; learn in secret who played it.

nazar.name: Royal Gaze
nazar.text: Place on a Vizier. This crisis, a Decree on them gives or takes 2 Influence, not 1.
nazar.flavor: The Sultan's gaze either raises you or burns you.

sukut.name: Silence
sukut.text: This player can't play an Intrigue card next wave.
sukut.flavor: In the palace, the silent live long.

divanda-nufuz.name: Sway in the Divan
divanda-nufuz.text: Unseat a Vizier with an Intrigue card.
divanda-nufuz.flavor: A vizier rises on a word and falls on a word.

suphe.name: Under Suspicion
suphe.text: Be a Vizier when Treason is played.

takdir.name: The Sultan's Esteem
takdir.text: Be a Vizier when Service is played.
takdir.flavor: One look from him is worth a thousand ducats.

gozden.name: Fall from Grace
gozden.flavor: The fallen have no friends, or only secret ones.

kulisci.name: Schemer
kulisci.text: Place Intrigue cards on three different players.

yukselen.name: Rising Star
yukselen.text: Be a Vizier in two crises.
yukselen.flavor: In the palace, rising is harder than staying up.

hedef.name: Lightning Rod
hedef.text: Have others place 2 or more Intrigue cards on you in one crisis.
hedef.flavor: The taller the tree, the more wind it catches.

ortak.name: Shared Fate
ortak.text: Place a Seal or a Pledge on a Vizier.
ortak.flavor: Those in the same boat sink together.

hazine.name: War Chest
hazine.text: Play 3 Intrigue cards in one crisis.
hazine.flavor: Save up, and you'll smile on the day of need.

koltuk.name: Seize a Seat
koltuk.text: Become a Vizier through an Intrigue card.

kulak.name: Eavesdropper
kulak.text: Use Deduction, Sealed Letter, Audit or Sentry.
kulak.flavor: Walls have ears, and doors have tongues.

yeniceri.name: Janissary Revolt
yeniceri.text: Players with 0 Influence draw 1 Intrigue card each.

hazine.name: Empty Treasury
hazine.text: Nobody may draw Intrigue cards this crisis.

venedik.name: Venetian Embassy
venedik.text: The two players beside Süleyman draw 1 Intrigue card each.

harem.name: Scandal in the Harem
harem.text: The poorest in Influence draws 1 Intrigue card; Süleyman breaks ties.

macar.name: Hungarian Campaign
macar.text: Nobody draws Intrigue cards this crisis.

muhur.name: The Lost Seal
muhur.text: Last crisis's Viziers draw 1 Intrigue card each.

divan.name: Uproar in the Divan
divan.text: Last crisis's Viziers draw 1 Intrigue card each.

sehzade.name: The Succession
sehzade.text: The two players beside Süleyman draw 1 Intrigue card each.

istanbul.name: Unrest in the City
istanbul.text: Everyone but Süleyman draws 1 Intrigue card.

irakeyn.name: Persian Campaign
irakeyn.text: The poorest in Influence draws 1 Intrigue card; Süleyman breaks ties.

isabella.name: Isabella Fortuna
isabella.text: Last crisis's Viziers draw 1 Intrigue card each.
isabella.flavor: A Castilian princess, sold to the Sultan by corsairs. She keeps trying to escape.

h.name: Service
text: Decree: Süleyman gives a Vizier 1 Influence.
h.flavor: Service to the state, loyalty to the Sultan.

x.name: Treason
text: Decree: Süleyman takes 1 Influence from a Vizier.
x.flavor: “My Sultan, I swear I wanted to help you, but I couldn't!”

loyalist.name: Loyalist
text: You win when 4 Service cards are on the Loyalty track.

traitor.name: Traitor
text: You win when 5 Treason cards are on the Treason track.
traitor.flavor: Those who wait in the shadows are patient.

sorusturma.name: Investigation
sorusturma.text: Süleyman names an investigator, who secretly looks at a player's Allegiance card, then says anything.

hazineDefteri.name: Treasury Ledger
hazineDefteri.text: Before the next crisis, Süleyman names a player, who looks in secret at the top 3 cards of the Fate deck.

fermanRefresh.name: Firman Renewed
fermanRefresh.text: Süleyman may use the Firman again. He never holds more than one.

strings.tagline: There's a traitor in the palace.
strings.endLoyalty: The fourth {term.hizmet} is played. The empire stands.
strings.pref.music.why: A quiet loop in the Hicaz mode.
